labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something does the wrong thing (in the guest, the page or the tools)

labels.name: flake
labels.description: A test that fails now and then: CI's reliability, not the product

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Something missing that a guest, a user or a developer would use

labels.name: perf
labels.description: Speed or memory: an opportunity or a regression, judged by measurements

labels.name: measure
labels.description: A number never taken, or one to take again

labels.name: cleanup
labels.description: Code, tests or docs to simplify, remove or restructure, with no change in behavior

labels.name: upstream
labels.description: Waits on another project (Chromium, the kernel, Mesa…) or is to be reported to one

labels.name: needs-human
labels.description: Needs the user: their hardware, a decision, or work only a person can do

labels.name: priority:high
labels.description: Set in triage: pick these first

labels.name: priority:medium
labels.description: Set in triage: worth doing when the area is touched

labels.name: priority:low
labels.description: Set in triage: only if it comes up
